recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further core-source work for FHIR-7251 is unnecessary unless a future work group decision explicitly asks to revive or document historical ProcessRequest/ProcessResponse behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-7251 was a Published/Not Persuasive with Modification Financial Management issue asking to reconcile ProcessRequest/ProcessResponse with Order/OrderResponse because they appeared to overlap; its later application note says the resources were removed and the standard was modified to use Task.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-7251 was found. Historical source changes applied the substance through resource retirement work: 16997a29 removed Order/OrderResponse source and active metadata, and GF #19345/642e610a commented ProcessRequest/ProcessResponse out of active build metadata and marked them as using Task.
additional_context: The closely related FHIR-19345 reconciliation is already present on the combined branch as f6ea10ab1b7b23006dd8f3229753b13010baaad7 and fixed remaining active Resource Guide and Task example residue. Current Financial Module content uses Task for the former process-request financial workflows, and a 2019 Zulip Resource Name Map thread confirms Order/OrderResponse merged into Task while ProcessRequest/ProcessResponse went partly to Task and partly to RESTful query patterns.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because active build metadata, current Financial Module guidance, Resource Guide content, and Task examples already reflect the reconciled end state.

related_jiras.note: Later Financial Management removal work for ProcessRequest and ProcessResponse; already represented on the combined branch and used only as context here.
